title: $$AIEN by Zaibots
tagline: Zaibots is an economic alliance for agents bringing the Yen carry trade on chain to drive liquidity
description:
Zaibots is an economic alliance working on agentic tools for defi.  This project is demonstrating bringing the yen carry trade on chain using Aave with a GHO fork, and a morpho trading strategy to automate a 10x, fully collateralized, leveraged carry trades against $AIEN to earn higher $USDC yield that is tokenized as tradable carryUSD token.  We are also creating an MCP server and skills for our stablecoins and low-interest loan infra to be accessible to all agentic workflows.

One team member Kiba is building a Zuzalu/Network State node in Japan called ZuCity Japan (zucity.org). ZuCity will use $AIEN to help with payments, property acquisitions, and the local community economy to grow our onchain and offchain presence in Japan.
how_its_made:
Most code written for this hack are in the jubc/src/contracts/custom for the morpho vault and aave integration with whack/ for agent interactions.

We used Aave v3, a morpho vault, a custom morpho adapter and strategy for our yen stablecoin and lending market, and tooling for an MCP and skills to use the defi strategies for agents. We simply reconfigure GHO to use a JPY chainlink oracle and then coded the morpho strategies to automate the carry trade and liquidity of carryUSD. The team partner coded in different areas all the elements and designed the project.  We tried to implement uniswap and yellow but mostly used standard defi tooling and solidity.
